description.value:
Trigger You hit a creature with an unarmed Strike.

You add one needle to that creature, to a maximum of 15.

At 5 needles it is enfeebled 1. At 10 it is blinded. At 14 it is stunned 2 and its Strikes lose all runes.

Granted by @UUID[Compendium.isaacs-hb-pf2e.saint-class-features.Item.Scorpio — the Needle]. Needles are tracked per creature and reset when it takes a full rest or the encounter ends; the resource on your sheet counts your current target.
